title: Lie Layer to Oscillator Isometry
body_html:
Lie Layer to Oscillator Isometry

Define symplectic forms on \(\mathbf g\) and \(\mathbf g'\) by \[ \langle X_1,X_2\rangle_\Gamma=B([X_1,X_2],\Gamma), \qquad \langle X_1',X_2'\rangle_{\Gamma'}=B([X_1',X_2'],\Gamma'). \] The map \[ \iota:\mathbf g\oplus\mathbf g'\to W,\qquad (X,X')\mapsto -wX+X'w \] is an isometry from \((\mathbf g\oplus\mathbf g',\langle,\rangle_\Gamma\oplus\langle,\rangle_{\Gamma'})\) to the symplectic space \(W\).
proof_html: For source terms, the trace pairing and \(w^\ast w=\Gamma\) give \[ B([X_1,X_2],\Gamma)=\langle -wX_1,-wX_2\rangle_W. \] The target calculation is identical using \(ww^\ast=\Gamma'\). The mixed pairing between \(-wX\) and \(X'w\) vanishes by cyclicity of trace and the adjoint convention, so the source and target summands are orthogonal. Combining the three computations proves the isometry.
